summary: Enhance your skills in natural resource management and biodiversity conservation with our comprehensive training course in LOCATION.
lede: Natural resource management balances human use of land and water with biodiversity and ecosystem protection. For professionals guiding projects, policies or investments, this course covers environmental risk screening, planning and monitoring mitigation measures, and involving communities in resource decisions. It also explores ecosystem services and how to assess environmental trade-offs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals and leaders who influence the use or protection of land, water, and biodiversity.
audience: Program and project managers in environment, climate
Corporate sustainability, ESG, or CSR professionals
Environmental and social safeguards officers in development
Natural resource officers in forestry, fisheries, wildlife
Planners and policymakers in land use, urban
modules: Foundations of Natural Resource Management and Biodiversity
Planning Conservation and Sustainable Use Measures
Climate Change, Resilience, and Nature-Based Solutions
Monitoring, Indicators, and Reporting for Conservation Results
Conflict Management and Stakeholder Engagement in Resource Use
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of environmental concepts and some experience in project management or policy development.
